_README: Curated designer-original -> cheaper-dupe seed pairs. FOUNDER CURATES THIS. match_pct is an EDITORIAL judgment (community consensus on how close the dupe smells), not an algorithmic score. source='editorial' = hand-picked marquee clone we stand behind; source='seed' = solid community-known pair. The importer (scripts/import-dupe-seeds.ts) resolves each {brand,name} to a catalog UUID and inserts into fragrance_dupes. Pairs whose dupe or original is not in the catalog are reported as UNRESOLVED so we know what to ingest. Both sides must exist; the dupe side must be purchasable to actually render.
